transformation: Projection to 12 variables; stations 3, 50, 100, cast1; pressure<=600 dbar. ERDDAP CSV retained verbatim, including units row. No invented observations.
quality_control: Notebook core retains both temperature and salinity WOCE CTD QC flag2 (acceptable); flag6 rows interpolated over>2dbar are reported and excluded.
